mapper.select: SELECT p.id::text AS publication_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM publication_reactions r WHERE r.publication_id=p.id AND r.kind='LIKE') AS like_count, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM publication_reactions r WHERE r.publication_id=p.id AND r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.kind='LIKE') AS liked, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM publication_reactions r WHERE r.publication_id=p.id AND r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.kind='BOOKMARK') AS bookmarked, (SELECT count(*) FROM publication_reactions r WHERE r.publication_id=p.id AND r.kind='BOOKMARK') AS bookmark_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM publication_events e WHERE e.publication_id=p.id AND e.kind='SHARE') AS share_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM publication_events e WHERE e.publication_id=p.id AND e.kind='VIEW') AS view_count FROM publications p WHERE p.is_deleted=false AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND p.delivery_status='AVAILABLE' AND p.id IN #{id}

SELECT e.id::text AS id, p.id::text AS publication_id, p.title, e.user_id::text AS user_id, ''::text AS actor_name, e.kind, e.created_at FROM publication_events e JOIN publications p ON p.id=e.publication_id WHERE e.kind IN ('LIKE','BOOKMARK','SHARE') AND e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND p.is_deleted=false AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND p.delivery_status='AVAILABLE' ORDER BY e.created_at DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT #{size}
